dataset: Walmart Recruiting II: Sales in Stormy Weather

benchmark_selection.exclusion_reason: Station 5 has M for all five weather fields on every history date; omit its six store-35 series to select exactly 50 supported pairs with observed weather.
benchmark_selection.ordering: Ascending numeric store_nbr, then item_nbr; one sequential request per store.
benchmark_selection.scope: 50 distinct trained store/item pairs, 29 distinct item_nbr values, 10 requests; fixed performance workload, not an accuracy cohort.

history_policy: 56 consecutive observed sales days; no sales imputation. Minimal earlier weather observations seed exact full-history causal fill, verified during build.
future_actuals: actuals.json is a separate comparison fixture; all input sales and weather dates are <= as_of.
expected_values: CPU float32 checkpoint predictions, clipped at zero then sorted across all five quantiles; rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-4.

legacy_sample.policy: Preserve the original main replay input and expected files byte-for-byte; the ten-product manifest uses separate store-specific files.
